shared_capture_contract: Use visual/fixture.json full1470x922 client, UTC clock, en/dark, actual font hashes. No scaling. Menu+scroll views need actual bounds verified. Source branch inventory is not screenshot evidence.

fixtures.core: Isolated sessions: s-alpha (title Alpha, workspaceA, providerA/shared-model), s-beta (Beta, workspaceB, providerB/shared-model), s-gamma (Gamma, workspaceA, providerA/model-x), s-removable last. Fixed UTC2026-10-25T12:00Z. At least one request per day Oct19–25 and earlier Oct12–18. Explicit input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite tokens, known prices on most requests, positive timestamp-gap duration on measured requests. One provider error, one tool failure, one abort, two named tools. Preserve genuine absence of other fields. Requests/providers/models/workspaces interned from actual JSONL; do not fake screen labels.
fixtures.comparison: core plus previous Oct12–18 tokens materially lower than Oct19–25 and one provider dominant; ensure compute produces source insight rows rather than directly inserting display strings.
fixtures.fully-priced: core with every request explicitly cost-bearing; no invented coverage badge.
fixtures.partly-priced: core with only some requests explicitly cost-bearing; retain unpriced request counts, no zero-cost imputation.
fixtures.latency-20: At least20 timed requests in displayed window AND in selected plotted buckets for genuine per-bucket p95; durations1s through20s, source nearest-rank p95=19s. Include source measured metadata.
fixtures.many-sessions: 31 distinct sessions s01–s31, titles Session01–Session31 and distinct totals for deterministic token-desc order; page size10; Last7 and no narrowing.
fixtures.core-plus-removal: core; scope last session then remove only that fixture session before scan, leaving globally valid providers/models/workspaces and remaining data.
fixtures.all-unreadable: Two isolated session files unparseable/unreadable under scanner semantics, index empty/unreadable_files=2. Fixture harness must validate result rather than assume arbitrary malformed JSON counts.
fixtures.delayed-first-index: Scanner seam holds initial UsageIndex delivery, no prior index. Freeze animation phase explicitly.
fixtures.delayed-refresh: Publish core then hold next UsageIndex delivery after Refresh. Keep previous index untouched.
fixtures.none: No source fixture can produce claimed combination; do not create fake screenshot.
